evidence.decision: Distinguishes flat ordered peers from hierarchy/destinations and chooses direct access when a large dot set becomes hard to use.
evidence.artifact: Requires a page/index/input contract or indicator/page specification with stable identity, order and supported movement.
evidence.transformation: Spatial gallery example removes false clickable hierarchy dots, chooses supported album controls and limits the indicator to peer position.
evidence.verification: Tests first/last, rapid changes, changed page counts and accessible alternate navigation, failing wrong index or unreachable essential pages.
evidence.applicability: Preserves noninteractive visionOS indicators, unsupported Mac control, iOS scrubbing/background-style constraints, TV focus and watch Crown paging.
evidence.handoffs: Loads scroll-views for page content and tab-bars only when the structure is actually top-level destinations.
evidence.distinctiveness: Indicator semantics, page identity synchronization and discrete-versus-rapid movement create a specific page-control procedure.
